name: dit_quantization_recovery_v3
hypothesis: Nonzero v2 actions remain below actual G10 thresholds; expand measured-geometry real G10 teacher lateral recovery coverage and warmstart the original near DiT.

data.factorial: 2targets x5 lateral20/35/50/75/100um x8 AB directions +2targets x2 Csigns x3 axial20/50/100um
data.collector: real strict RGB2/OCT + teacher-only measured-geometry inverse and nearest executable G10 candidate; no true XYZ in action decisions
data.trajectory: 2 actual prefix ticks +64 teacher ticks; one observation per motor timestamp; no in-flight reset
data.labels: actual safety-accepted ABC; genuine contiguous future16; no synthetic label/interpolation/padding
data.reuse: v2 real E40/E42 teacher windows only where sensor lateral<=5um, to retain axial/hold behavior
data.balance: stationary executable recovery / recovery / new hold / v2 axial retention

architecture.inputs: unchanged two OCT frames + measured velocity from actual encoder frames + previous accepted ABC; same RGB/absoluteABC mask
architecture.masked: vision tokens constant0 + original learned temporal constants; absoluteABC constant0 inside original condition
architecture.path: all inputs through original condition encoders + six DiT blocks + four original midpoint RF steps; directABC
architecture.frozen: vision weights and untouched farv5; all nonvision DiT/condition weights trainable
architecture.output_scales: frozen v2 train-only mean/std; no external gain, geometric correction or command accumulator during policy evaluation

training.loss: first-action normalized MSE +.02 genuine16-action MSE +.002 original RF loss
training.precision: v2 FP32 parity with TF32 off; shared trainer AMP defaults unchanged
training.validation: E40/E42-only fixed offline recovery/hold diagnostics; finite loss/gradient, all6blocks changed; no E41 fitting/scales
training.checkpoints: every600 and finally, optimizer plus CPU/CUDA/sampler RNG

near.gate: original50+-1um start, two actual prefix ticks,nonzero actual incoming velocity, valid RGB2
near.baseline: old campaign and saved original exec1 trajectories read-only

standard.dependency: all4 E41 development strict pass and E40/E42 training coverage
standard.start: fresh production RCMSceneV9 constructor default, target set only; original first-cycle history warmup zero retained
standard.route: original v5 until valid observable OCT norm<=100um then fixed-noise near DiT, one-way no state/velocity/accepted/history reset
standard.strict: each all last200 independent postXYZ<=20um including final, all5 required

protocol.truth: initialization and independent postXYZ scoring only
protocol.history: shared continuous actual two-frame history; previousaccepted and velocity never reset at100um switch
protocol.gate: all4 E41 real50um x240: all last200 independent postXYZ<=20um including final; otherwise stop with four trajectories
protocol.standard: E00/E02/E06/E08/E10 x1600; originalv5 to valid measuredOCT<=100um then newnearDiT
protocol.bias: report old/new postXYZ, signed OCTC, acceptedC and crossing actions; bound independentXYZ for disappearance

near_regression_branch.trigger: any of four E41 strict20um gates fails
near_regression_branch.diagnosis: save last200 independent XYZ/signedOCT/acceptedABC/encoder hold counts against v2
near_regression_branch.repair: one1200update fit atlr1e-5 initialized from candidate1; same E40/E42-only data with increased axial/hold retention; no E41 relabeling
near_regression_branch.next: repeat original four E41 starts once; only4/4 strict pass authorizes standard five
near_regression_branch.stop: second near strict failure blocks standard; retain all results

budget_policy: All stage caps subordinate to ONE shared2700s deadline; workers terminate at2670 with30s cleanup reserve
launch: once in new GNOME; FIFO actual PID acknowledgement only; no postlaunch wait/poll
reporting: root/local TEST_LOG locked/fsync/readback each outcome; real RGB/OCT, raw/clipped/accepted actions, requested/quantized/actual encoder values and independent pre/postXYZ
implementation_scope: all modified implementation under new run directory; root TEST_LOG append only
